evals.prompt:
帮我批改这篇雅思作文：

题目：Some people think that the best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences. Others believe there are better alternatives. Discuss both views.

作文：
Nowadays, crime is a big problem in many countries. Some people think we should put criminals in prison for long time to stop crime. But other people think there are better ways to solve this problem. I will discuss both views.

First, longer prison sentences can stop crime because criminals will be afraid to go to prison for many years. If they know they will lose their freedom for long time, they will not want to do bad things. Also, when criminals are in prison, they cannot hurt people on the outside. This keeps society safe.

However, there are other ways to reduce crime. Education is very important. If we teach children about right and wrong when they are young, they will not become criminals. Also, we can help poor people because many crimes happen because people need money. If the government gives jobs to people, they will not steal. Rehabilitation is also good because prisoners can learn new skills and find jobs when they leave prison.

In conclusion, both longer prison sentences and other methods can help reduce crime. I think the best way is to use both methods together. We should punish criminals but also help them become better people.

evals.prompt:
请评分这篇 Task 1：

The chart shows the percentage of people who used the internet in three different age groups in the UK between 2000 and 2010.

The chart shows internet usage by age group from 2000 to 2010. Overall, all age groups increased their internet use. Young people used the internet most.

In 2000, 15-24 age group had 25% internet usage. 25-44 group had 15%. 45+ group had only 5%.

By 2005, young people increased to 60%. The middle group went up to 40%. The oldest group rose to 20%.

In 2010, the youngest group reached 85%. The 25-44 group was 65%. The 45+ group was 35%.

To conclude, internet usage went up for everyone but young people always used it more.

evals.prompt:
帮我把这篇低分作文改写成高分范文：

Topic: Some people believe that children should be taught to be competitive. Others think cooperation is more important.

Essay:
I think children should learn both competition and cooperation. Both are important for life.

Competition is good because it makes children try harder. When children compete, they want to be the best. This helps them study more and get better grades. Also, in the future, they need to compete for jobs.

Cooperation is also important. When children work together, they learn to share and help each other. In real life, people need to work in teams. If children only learn competition, they cannot work with others.

In my opinion, schools should teach both. Competition makes children strong. Cooperation makes children kind. Both are needed for a good life.
